description: Satellite imagery depicting a landscape in Southern Spain, featuring undulating terrain with light-coloured, sparsely vegetated land. In the bottom-left, a winding river or wadi, appearing blue-green, flows through an area of dense red-coloured vegetation, characteristic of false colour infrared imagery often used to highlight healthy vegetation. Further north and east, smaller patches of similar reddish vegetation are visible against the lighter background. The image illustrates a dry environment with varying degrees of vegetation cover, typical of CLMS land cover class 6.1 "Sparsely vegetated land". The credit for the image is M. Palacios.
